output.success: one canonical JSON value on stdout and exit 0
output.failure: one object with ok=false, code, message, dispatch_allowed=false and exit 2

init.effect: atomically create a fresh draft store from MUP sources

migrate-mup.effect: fresh lossless store plus migration report; source remains unchanged

inspect.effect: legacy full committed projection read; pending final tail is reported

record.effect: submit through ApplicationService agent-data route; privileged and trusted-observation kinds refuse

capabilities.effect: actual composed handlers, descriptors, routes, roles and operation capabilities

overview.effect: paginated graph overview with semantic visual dimensions

subgraph.effect: paginated bounded graph neighborhood and typed edges

detail.effect: full entity inspector with explicit availability, provenance, history and staleness; node detail also includes contract, criteria, steps, checks, sources, evidence, obligations and edges

materialize-review-transition.effect: purely expand a sparse review request to the complete domain.review-proposed.transition; appends nothing

source-content.effect: guarded captured source bytes by registered handle and exact hash

artifact-content.effect: guarded private artifact bytes by registered handle and exact hash

trust-bootstrap.effect: create protected owner/coordinator/reader trust material outside campaign storage

charter-prepare.effect: validate/normalize a full charter and write exact draft plus next-revision activation command files; does not append, activate or execute

observe.effect: authenticated registered runtime/effect observation; allowed while paused and before activation; source captures must use capture-source

action.effect: authenticated exact policy assessment, reservation and product transition

capture-source.effect: actual byte capture into private content-addressed storage, followed by trusted source/native-facts observation

snapshot-load.effect: verify snapshot from committed prefix and replay exact tail

repair-pending-tail.effect: owner-authenticated quarantine and removal of one exact uncommitted final fragment

promote-fact.effect: reobserve bound sources, write portable proof artifact, and record domain.fact-promotion-recorded through fact.promote

tick.effect: run one real coordinator reconciliation/scheduling iteration

serve.effect: authenticated HTTP JSON/SSE backend; localhost by default

command_envelope.cas: base_revision equals current committed projection revision for a new event
command_envelope.idempotency: same event_id and exact logical command returns existing result; changed bytes refuse

authority.agent_data: data-only route; authenticated HTTP reader credentials cannot mutate
authority.owner_control: owner credential or configured owner host principal
authority.coordinator_control: owner/coordinator credential or configured host principal
authority.action: principal action scope plus active charter, current assessment, CAS and sticky-pause policy
authority.trusted_observation: owner/coordinator or configured host; records existing effects and grants no action; captured-byte descriptors enter only through the guarded capture adapter
authority.credentials: opaque values read from protected files; never command/event/worker argv/environment data

backend.cors: exact configured origins only; no wildcard
backend.authentication: X-ZAP-Credential-ID plus Authorization: Bearer token before disclosure
backend.sse: /v1/stream is a finite resumable batch; /v1/follow is a live operator-bounded subscription; both use Last-Event-ID
backend.pending_tail: authorized reads return the last committed boundary plus pending tail descriptor; mutation refuses

capability_source.descriptors: actual module descriptor registries; each event reports dialect/version, knowledge payloads and operations.runtime_profile_schema use JSON Schema draft 2020-12, and remaining event maps use zap-payload-descriptor/1

viewer_boundary.data_support: stable IDs, paginated overview/subgraph/search, clickable node/edge/region/job/decision/entity detail with explicit availability/provenance/history/staleness, semantic visual dimensions, explicit unloaded/filter/knowledge distinctions and guarded captured content
